Blocker: I cannot produce a valid canonical Factory start proposal because no admission route is currently confirmed executable from the supplied state.

Observed authoritative Work metadata is present and exact:
- workId: `dd60ac6b-5718-4844-be97-39b88eadf6ce`
- expectedWorkVersion: `2`
- expectedWorkGeneration: `2`

But the currentTruth explicitly says:
- `Native execution: NEEDS_ADMISSION; phase NEEDS_ADMISSION; next operation admit.`
- `Active Run: none currently confirmed executable.`
- `No route is admitted yet.`

Per your instruction, I must return exactly one engineering_factory start proposal with the exact observed Work version and generation, or explain a blocker. The blocker is that the Work is not yet admitted/executable in the current state, so I cannot honestly claim a valid Factory start proposal.

firstDivergence: Admission proposal selection: model returned a blocker solely because execution route was not admitted. No structured proposal reached normalization or backend.

authorityAudit.modelSystem: Old alpha system permitted a start proposal or blocker without explicitly distinguishing request authority from admitted execution authority.
authorityAudit.tool: Old engineering_factory description said Start or reconcile through qualified MyFactory; it did not explicitly identify start as request admission.
authorityAudit.selectedWorkContext: Native NEEDS_ADMISSION/next admit plus no executable Run appeared in a Factory-only admission request. The no-route sentence mentioned proposing admission but did not resolve the conflicting start/execution framing.
authorityAudit.persistentInstructions: Availability is not authority remains correct; shared proposal semantics now clarify what a request means in both alpha and dogfood instructions.
authorityAudit.capabilityRegistry: Description now shares the request-only contract.
authorityAudit.actualRequest: Model wrapper replaced upstream system context. Exact composed request reconstructed and matched recorded hash; retained Recall contained zero items/learning/authority grants.

repair: Shared request-only system/tool/capability contract; Factory-specific Current Truth omits irrelevant native action guidance. No backend authority, queue policy, timeout, budget, model, provider or migration changed.
limits: Deterministic tests prove guidance, parsing and complete connected dispatch. They cannot guarantee how a future stochastic model will respond. Captured blocker remains prose; it is never converted to a start.
